title: Save Without Quitting (:w)
instruction_text:
You don't always want to quit when saving!

:w  = save (write) the file
:wq = save and quit

Your task:
1. Press 'A' to append at end of line
2. Type ' - edited'
3. Press ESC
4. Type :w and press ENTER (file saves, Vim stays open)
5. Verify the status line shows the save
6. Type :q and press ENTER to quit

Note: You can also use :wq as usual.
